internalReviewConclusion.finding: A significant share of internal_review is duplicate discovery noise, navigation/index content, historical material or fragments of opportunities that already have canonical public records. Promotion-gap auditing must always deduplicate against canonical opportunities before classifying a held record as missed.

waveConclusion: No new current actionable gap was established on the municipality-applicability/internal-review/national-route axis. Two Wave 8 municipality-fanout findings are retracted. Spiagge Sicure is correctly excluded for the seven municipalities, AMIF remains an unresolved national-route watch, and the DAIT design-contribution case is historical. The audit nevertheless remains open and implementation remains frozen because other known families have not yet completed saturation sweeps.
